title: I Built A Business From Scratch Only Following Claude's Advice
promo_conflict: The speaker promotes Inkbook as a working product, but says customer acquisition and profitability have not yet been tested; no customer or sales results are given.

stated_problem.quote: None of the software was particularly impressive.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Tattoo shop booking and CRM (Inkbook)
idea.one_liner: Web booking and CRM software for tattoo shops, with its revenue model not stated.
idea.offer: Online booking, scheduling, payments and deposits, messaging, appointment reminders, digital waivers, design galleries, project tracking and artist payouts.
idea.revenue_model: Not stated; no Inkbook fee or payment plan is disclosed.

key_quotes.quote: There weren't really that many competitors.
None of the software was particularly impressive.
And the most important thing, almost nobody was bidding on Google Ads.
So I decided to go all in on tattoo shop booking software.
It's basically a full CRM for tattoo shops.
online booking, payments and deposits, so they can collect payments from their customers, AI messaging, automated reminders
And we landed on Inkbook as the name, so inkbook.io.

claims.claim: Claude said low keyword competition could make paid advertising profitable because cost per click would be low.
claims.quote: Then, Claude said it could help me automate Google Ads and Facebook Ads so that we can run them profitably cuz cost per click would be so low cuz there wasn't much competition.

claims.claim: The speaker expected low competition to keep ad costs low and allow profitable customer acquisition.
claims.quote: If very few companies are competing for these keywords, advertising costs stay low, which means we could acquire customers profitably.

claims.claim: The speaker says the software, backend and homepage were functioning within a few days.
claims.quote: Within a few days, I had a software, back-end functionality, and a homepage, and everything was functioning.

claims.claim: The speaker says he had an actual working product after only a few days of work.
claims.quote: So, after only a few days of work, I had something that looked like a real software company, not a mock-up, not screenshots, an actual working product.

claims.claim: The speaker cautions that starting one of the discussed businesses does not guarantee making money.
claims.quote: Just because you start one of these doesn't mean you're going to make money.

acquisition_channels.details: Claude proposed automating Google Ads and Facebook Ads; the speaker says he will start running ads in a later video, so results are not yet reported.

ideas.delivery: The speaker and Claude built a functioning web product and demo. The speaker says it was ready to be pushed, while customer acquisition was still pending.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to tattoo client records and waivers; PECR governs electronic marketing messages. If Inkbook uses recurring subscriptions, DMCC Act subscription rules may apply.
